title: Grateful Dead Live at Campus Stadium - University Of California on 1973-05-20
lineage: CD -> EAC -> Samplitude Professional v9.11 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of the classic May 20 1973 UCSB show, highlighted by a soaring 19‑minute Playing in the Band and stellar third‑set jams.
ai_review.review: The recording, a Charlie Miller‑sourced 1973 soundboard, delivers crystal‑clear instrumentation with only occasional minor imperfections. Musically the concert is solid throughout, featuring an epic Playing In The Band, powerful third‑set performances of Nobody's Jam, The Other One and Eyes of the World, and standout moments like Sunshine and Box of Rain. Overall listeners rave about both the historic vibe and the high‑fidelity sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.7/5 with consistent praise for both performance and audio quality; only a few minor critiques exist, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised as 'pristine', 'top‑shelf' and 'stunning' sound; occasional tech glitches noted (minor wind noise on earlier tapes now cleaned up, a few non‑pristine moments), but overall clear, balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A strong first set builds into an unforgettable 19‑minute Playing In The Band, while the third set delivers the show's high point with extended jams and emotional vocals; overall pacing is praised despite a few shakier first‑set renditions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His raspy 1973 voice is noted as unique; reviewers admire his passionate singing even when battling a cold.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as 'fired up' and delivering emotive bass work throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboard work is highlighted as solid with plenty of presence, and Donna’s harmonies are praised as angelic.
